doc.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Louis Armstrong, Basie and New York studio scene
title: John Hammond's attempt to place Hinton and Cozy Cole at CBS
summary: Hammond arranged for Hinton and Cozy to go on CBS staff, but the offer dissolved when Cab was pressed to give up Cozy.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Was Billy Taylor the bass player, the first black musician on CBS, do you know?
I think Stretch Paylor was the first black musician at CBS.
I know Billy was on staff there for a while.
Billy was on staff. Well that is another story. I was supposed to get that job. When Cozy Cole and I were with Cab Calloway, the time we went [unintelligible] was out in California…
And when Charlotte was born and we were in California, that era…

John Hammond went to the CBS people, he was connected with Columbia being at Vanderbilt and he was on the Board of Directors of the NAACP. And he went to the powers at CBS and said, “We have got to get some black musicians in here.” And whatever happened, they said, well they have got to be some good ones.” Cab Calloway was playing the Strand Theatre. Now this I have never told anybody before. I don‟t remember. We was playing the Strand Theatre. John Hammond came down to the Strand Theatre, came up to Cab‟s dressing room and says, “Look I am trying to get some musicians into CBS but I have got to have guys that are good disciplinarians and guys that can read music and know how to handle themselves. And if I can get them in there, these are the kinds of guys I have got to offer. I need Milt and I need Cozy.” He said he had gone to Duke and asked Duke for some musicians. He said, “If I can get Milt and I can get Cozy I am sure it will work out. Cab says, “Okay.” We close the Strand Theatre. Our next engagement was the Chicago Theatre in Chicago. That‟s my hometown.

I go tell my momma about it, that I think I am going to get a job on staff at CBS. And I am telling my friends goodbye. I never heard one word about that. The next thing I know Cozy and I…the next engagement from Chicago Theatre was the Million Dollar Ballroom in California, Los Angeles. We are on the train and we go out there and we get out to the Million Dollar Ballroom, Cozy and I are still in Cab‟s band. Cab gets a message that they are not going to use anybody because he is not keeping his word that he is not letting the guys go. So they discuss it with Cozy. He is the star and I was nobody. So he said, “Okay if you give us Cozy we will let the things go.” So Cab gave Cozy Cole up and we got JC Hurt from Detroit that came into the band. John Simmons got the job, Sue Simmons father.
John Simmons got the job in there. My heart was broken because I didn‟t get the gig. Now Billy Taylor came…
